questions.text: What are the economic objectives of business?
questions.text_as_printed: What are the economic objectives of business? (A)

answer.value:
Economic objectives of business
• The main economic objective of business is to earn profit.
• Business supplies goods and services to consumers and creates customers.
• It produces goods in sufficient quantity by using resources.

• They bear business losses themselves.
• They classify goods according to quantity and provide them according to customer preferences.
• They provide credit facilities to customers.
• They inform customers about new products in the market.
• If a particular product is not available, they inform about alternative products.

questions.text: Explain the need for foreign trade for a country.
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the need for foreign trade for a country. (A)

answer.value:
Need for foreign trade
• No country in the world is self-sufficient in all resources.
• Some countries have an abundance of certain resources.
• Using those resources, they produce certain goods in excess.
• After meeting the country's demand, the remaining goods are exported to other countries.
• Countries lacking resources import the goods they need from other countries.
• Therefore, every country needs foreign trade.
• Foreign trade helps in maintaining friendly relations among countries.
